capabilities: insert images from local files or stock photo services (Unsplash, Pexels, Pixabay)
rename pasted or inserted images using template variables and deduplication
convert remote image URLs to local files on open, save, or batch
paste images directly into properties with configurable link formats
display banner images from properties with device-specific styling
extras: Part of the Vault CMS project aimed at Astro sites; supports MDX files in addition to Markdown. Unsplash search works without an API key through a default proxy server. The README also promotes a paid companion app, Zeku.
intentEvidence: unifies functionality from multiple image-related plugins into one cohesive experience
problem: Obsidian's default image insertion and attachment handling lacks rename prompts, stock photo search, remote-to-local conversion, and banner display, which previously required several separate plugins.
